title: EzyJob KSA — Recommend and scrape (for frontend)
note: Same endpoints as before. No new path. Recommend ranks by skills, certifications, and experience. If SCRAPE_KEYWORDS in .env is empty, that setting is ignored. The scrape searches skills and certifications stored in MySQL, not a fixed role list. Experience is used only to rank, not to search boards.

keywords.use: Leave empty. The API then searches skills and certifications from the database. If you send python,sql, only those words are searched.

sample_response.message: Scrape started. Poll GET /api/scrape/status until running is false, then check the ksajob.jobs table.

status.use: Call until running is false. Do not treat the previous error as the result of the scrape you just started.

by_user.use: Recommended Roles for the logged-in user. The API reads that user's skills, certifications, and work history from the database. Do not send the password.

by_body.use: Use when the screen has the skill list, certification list, and work history in hand. Job titles and years come from resume.experience.

new_response_fields.skills: Skills used to rank this response.
new_response_fields.certifications: Certifications used to rank this response.
new_response_fields.experience_titles: Past job titles used to rank this response.
new_response_fields.years: Candidate years used to rank. Null when dates are missing.
new_response_fields.hint: Null when jobs were found. A string when nothing matched.
new_response_fields.jobs[].match.score: 0 to 100. Sort is already done. Highest score is first.
new_response_fields.jobs[].match.missing_skills: Candidate skills not found on this job.
new_response_fields.jobs[].match.missing_certifications: Candidate certifications not found on this job.
new_response_fields.jobs[].match.matched_titles: Past titles that overlap this job title.
new_response_fields.jobs[].match.experience_fit: match, stretch, unknown, or none. match means years and level are close.
